shortDefinition.en: An image sensor implemented using CMOS technology, commonly with active pixel circuitry.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 采用 CMOS 技术实现、通常集成有源像素电路的图像传感器。

en: CMOS alone does not specify Bayer, X-Trans, BSI, stacked construction or global-shutter timing.
zh-cn: CMOS 不能单独指定 Bayer、X-Trans、背照式、堆栈结构或全局快门时序。

example.en: The X-T5's X-Trans CMOS name combines sensor technology and color sampling.
example.zh-cn: X-T5 的 X-Trans CMOS 名称同时包含传感器技术与彩色采样方式。

en: CMOS technology permits integration of amplification, addressing and readout circuitry. Implementation choices matter. Read construction, color sampling and exposure timing as separate fields; the acronym alone cannot predict image quality or color.
zh-cn: CMOS 技术允许集成放大、寻址与读出电路，实际实现方式很重要。应把器件结构、彩色采样和曝光时序视为独立字段，不能只用缩写预测画质或色彩。
